title: Deep Research Lanes
headline: /learn --deep also runs NotebookLM Deep Research, and Gemini app Deep Research through Chrome.
plain: Today --deep runs one Exa or Tavily deep-research job. We add two more lanes. The first runs several focused NotebookLM Deep Research jobs inside the topic's notebook and imports their best sources without passing the notebook's source cap. The second opens gemini.google.com in Chrome, runs Deep Research reports one at a time, and puts each report into the notebook. Both lanes skip cleanly when their tool is missing.
need: Two new reference files that hold the step-by-step procedure for each lane
SKILL.md changes: tool probes, flags, the lane steps, error rows and one example
A version bump to 2.5.0 and doc updates
assumes: NotebookLM's research tools (research_start, research_status, research_import) are on the notebooklm-mcp server the plugin already lists
A Deep Research run needs an existing notebook; today the notebook is created later, in Phase 3
Gemini runs only one Deep Research job at a time: today two parallel runs failed with an error
The research_status task id can differ from the one research_start returned
Google Support has told users that automating the Gemini app is not permitted, so the Gemini lane carries account risk

flow.title: Probe
flow.text: Phase 0 also looks for NotebookLM's research tools and for Claude in Chrome.

flow.title: NotebookLM lane
flow.text: With --deep, create the notebook early and run focused Deep Research jobs one after another, importing the top sources of each within the cap.

flow.title: Gemini lane
flow.text: When enabled, open Gemini in Chrome, pick Deep research, submit a detailed prompt, confirm the plan, wait, copy the report and add it to the notebook.

flow.title: Synthesis
flow.text: Report text is read back and turned into digests for the summary, the learning page and the decision material.

questions.q: When does the Gemini app lane run?
questions.today: The skill never opens the Gemini app. Today you asked for it by hand.
questions.why: It drives your signed-in Google account through a browser. Google Support has said that kind of automation is not permitted, and each report takes 5-60 minutes.
questions.pick: Choose when the lane runs and how many reports it may start.
questions.get: Long Gemini reports in the notebook without you doing the clicking.
questions.skip: Only NotebookLM's built-in Deep Research runs; no Gemini app reports.

Automatically with every --deep run when Chrome is connected

questions.q: When should NotebookLM Deep Research run?
questions.today: The notebook is created in Phase 3, after the web research and synthesis.
questions.why: Running it early lets its sources and report feed the synthesis; running it late keeps today's phase order.
questions.get: Either a richer synthesis, or a smaller change.
questions.skip: The lane can't run, because it needs a notebook.

options.t: In Phase 1b: create the notebook early, run the jobs, read the reports back into the digests
In Phase 3: run the jobs after the notebook is created; the synthesis doesn't use them

questions.q: How does a Gemini report get into the notebook?
questions.why: Copying the text is simple and keeps everything in this session; exporting to Google Docs keeps formatting and links but writes files to your Drive.
questions.get: The report as a notebook source, plus a local copy in the research folder.
questions.skip: Reports stay only in the Gemini chat.

options.t: Read the report text from the page, save it locally, add it as a text source
Export to Google Docs, then add the Doc as a Drive source

defaults.label: NotebookLM Deep Research jobs per --deep run

options.t: The report plus the top 12 sources, kept under the 98-source threshold
Up to 60 minutes, checking about every 5 minutes; then report it as still running

challenge.does: It adds two optional deep-research lanes to /learn --deep, each with its own reference file.
challenge.alternatives: The simplest version is the NotebookLM lane only, which uses tools the plugin already connects to and carries no account risk.
challenge.consequences: The Gemini lane depends on Gemini's web UI, which changed twice in today's run (the menu moved under More tools), so it will need upkeep.
